summary: - **[key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper#490](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper/pull/490)**: Fixes Marlin random seeds not being refreshed for each event. The wrapper detected a new event by comparing `LCEvent` pointers, but new events are often allocated at the same address, so many events reused identical seeds and therefore identical smearing patterns. A regression test now checks that seeds change between events.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#64](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/64)**: `GaussSmearVertex` and `FlatSmearVertex` now shift the whole HepMC3 event position, so beam particles start at the smeared interaction point instead of staying at (0,0,0). All other vertices keep the same smeared positions as before. Fixes #63.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1691](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1691)**: `HepMC3EventReader` now applies the HepMC3 length unit to the primary vertex x/y/z coordinates. Files in millimetres were unaffected, but HepMC3 files using centimetres previously gave wrong primary vertex positions in simulation.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1678](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1678)**: `Geant4EventAction` now throws when shared actions are used in single-threaded mode, where they previously misbehaved silently (e.g. output plugins writing events twice). The DDSim `OutputConfig` example for user output plugins is corrected for multi-threaded running. Steering files that mark output plugins as shared must be adapted; FCC-config#391 does this for the IDEA and ALLEGRO steering files.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1689](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1689)**: The EDM4hep file reader now correctly handles the new MDI synchrotron radiation files, which contain parentless photons. These photons now start Geant4 tracking at their vertex rather than their endpoint. The HepMC3 reader does not yet support this event structure.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#434](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/434)**: Fixes two long-standing `OverlayTiming` bugs. `StartBackgroundEventIndex` was reapplied every event, so the same background events were overlaid repeatedly; the start position is now set once at initialization. `AllowReusingBackgroundFiles` was never enforced. Jobs that relied on the silent wrap-around now fail and must set the option explicitly.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#72](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/72)**: Adds optional 4D (time-aware) tracking to `CKFTrackingAlg`, using hit time as a CKF measurement dimension plus an ACTS doublet-seeding time cut. Per-sensor time resolutions are configured as placeholders until EDM4hep stores a per-hit time error (EDM4hep#527). The feature requires a recent ACTS version.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#122](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/122)**: Removes the legacy `ACTSSeededCKFTrackingAlg` together with `ACTSAlgBase`, `GeometryIdMappingTool` and `GeometryIdSelector`; users should switch to `CKFTrackingAlg`. Tag v00-05 is the last version that still contains the old algorithm.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#72](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/72)**: `ConformalTracking` gains `ECalBarrelFaceSystemID`/`ECalEndcapFaceSystemID` properties, which default to the CLD/ILD values. This allows track-state extrapolation to the calorimeter face for detectors such as ALLEGRO (system IDs 4/5). `GaudiDDKalTest` now also recognizes EM calorimeters by their type flags. Fits no longer fail when no calorimeter-face track state is found.

- **[PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent#41](https://github.com/PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent/pull/41)**: Adds photon and hadronic energy-correction plugins that look up the correction in a 2D (theta, energy) table. Corrections are applied inside Pandora, so clusters, PFOs and jets stay consistent. The change has no effect unless the new options are enabled and a table is supplied.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#109](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/109)**: Fixes `TracksFromGenParticles` with `ExtrapolateToECal=False`, where uninitialized ECAL geometry was still read and tracks could randomly get calorimeter states extrapolated with garbage geometry. Further fixes: Extrapolation now only runs when requested. cellIDs are no longer truncated to 32 bits. Geometry lookup failures return a failure status instead of throwing.

- **[HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter#286](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/286)**: Rewrites `PairCaloClustersPi0` to use Boost.Graph maximum matching (N³) instead of an exhaustive exponential search. The algorithm was previously unusable on hadronic events because it exhausted memory. Results are validated as identical up to output ordering.

omitted.reason: Allows sourcing older nightlies for LCG-based stacks and adds CI tests for the setup scripts.
Dependabot bump of int128/docker-manifest-create-action to 2.29.0.
Centralises the benchmark run-store layout in a shared module and replaces positional rank-group tuple access with named fields.
Dependabot bump of peter-evans/create-pull-request to 8.1.1.
Dependabot bump of streamlit to 1.65.0.
Enables TLS (default "prefer") for backend database connections so encrypted-only DBOD instances can be used.
Fixes the frontend API URL setting not taking effect at runtime by documenting `NUXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL`.
Renames the project to Dataset Metadata Interface (DaMI) and adds a staging deployment pipeline.
Adds a tag-triggered production deployment job to GitLab CI.
Requires Boost 1.70 and uses CONFIG mode for Boost in `DD4hepConfig.cmake`, silencing CMP0167 warnings downstream.
Runs the ACTS master CI directly in the Key4hep job container with CVMFS mounted explicitly.
Adds a verbose option to the CLI and API, and switches the material kind to silence a GLTFExporter warning.
Health endpoints now accept HEAD requests for uptime monitors.
Adds `/healthz` and `/readyz` endpoints and Kubernetes startup/liveness probes.
Fixes a backend mypy error and adds a GitHub workflow running ruff and mypy on PRs.
Adds CORS headers to 500 responses and stops returning exception details to clients.
Adds a local customization point for `LCCaloHit`, allowing calorimeter-hit extensions without touching PandoraSDK; results are unchanged.
Energy-correction plugin `IsValid` now checks that scale factors are positive and finite.
Fixes `CollectionMerger` copy mode, rejects empty input lists that caused a segfault, and makes merging exception-safe. Lower priority.
`OverlayTiming` now validates property sizes and the `UniqueIDGenSvc` at initialization, and per-event logging is reduced to debug. Lower priority.
Adds logging of the number of TBB threads used during parallel seeding and CKF in `CKFTrackingAlg`.
Drops redundant edge deduplication in GNNTrackFinding; classifier scores may differ in the last bits.
GNNTrackFinding prints the graph after each pipeline stage via a `GnnHook` debug hook.
Removes unused ACTS headers in `CKFTrackingAlg`, cutting compile memory by about 32%.
GNNTrackFinding cleanup that switches to native Gaudi list properties and rejects old comma-separated string configurations. Lower priority.
Requires EDM4hep 1.0 and removes the pre-1.0 cluster phi compatibility check.
Factorizes the common Gaudi digi/reco configuration shared by ALLEGRO o1 and o2 into a common module.
Sets the shared flag for user output plugins according to the thread count in IDEA and ALLEGRO steering files, following DD4hep#1678. Lower priority.
Supports the FieldMap-based persistency interface of PandoraSDK v03 while remaining buildable with older versions.
Adds a CI workflow that builds against PandoraSDK master.
GNNTrackFinding requires an edge-feature phi scale of pi when computing edge features; other configurations now fail at initialization. Lower priority.
GNNTrackFinding: `EdgeBuildingKnn` becomes a positive int, ONNX model-loading errors reach the Gaudi log, and minor cleanups. Lower priority.
Adds HEP-FCC repositories to the exclude list of the commits-after-tag check.
Removes CEPC repositories from the commits-after-tag check.
Refactors `GGTFTrackFinder`, fixes wire-collection index bookkeeping, and stops storing the noise/unclustered-hit track. Lower priority.
Fixes uninitialized-variable warnings in `VTXdigitizerDetailed`.
Bumps the benchmarked ALLEGRO o1, CLD o2 and IDEA o1 geometries to their latest versions while continuing the regression history across detector switches.
Automates detector-version bump PRs for benchmarks based on the versions available in the nightly.
Allows dispatching a subset of nightly benchmark jobs.
Defaults absent `sweep`/`verbose` keys to false in the benchmark matrix.
Fixes an unused lambda capture warning.
Renovate bump of marked to 18.1.0.
Removes std::filesystem detection logic and requires GCC 9.1+.
Makes the LCG-based workflow triggerable from the GitHub web UI.
GNNTrackFinding requires ACTS ≥ 48.1.0 and passes edge-classifier features in the configured order. Lower priority.
Fixes a CMake typo that installed ARCdigi/VTXdigi headers to the wrong path.
Splits the timed-process runner from ddsim and centralises run-artifact contracts.
Updates the Delphes+EvtGen tutorial section to the latest Key4hep stack and the FCC-config `main` branch.
Fixes file names in the FCC-hh example digi+reco test script when Pythia is used.
Raises the ALLEGRO o2 STT digitizer readout window from 450 to 600 ns. Lower priority.
Replaces priority dots with border accents and polishes request views.
Shrinks the Request Details grid gap to match the rest of the page.
Makes textareas resizable and adds auto-grow with a fallback.
Renders Markdown in Additional Notes and removes dead edit templates.
Adds a Detector(s) field, required for final processing stages other than generation.
Overhauls seed data and fixes a `use_case` enum mismatch.
Fixes a duplicate header on session expiry and silent 403s in htmx requests.
Renovate bump of the postgres Docker tag to v18.
Renovate bump of Node.js to v24.
Runs the built Docker image against Postgres in CI rather than only building it.
The example `TestSteppingAction` no longer suspends dead tracks, which caused a G4Exception since Geant4 11.4.3.
Removes the unused variable `s_exit_handler_active` flagged by Clang 23.
